text: In 1966, a court in Yugoslavia banned Miloš Moskovljević's Dictionary of Modern Serbo-Croatian Language. The Belgrade District Court ordered the entire edition destroyed over three or four words described as disturbing to the Central Committee of Serbia. UDBA then searched across Serbia for copies sent to subscribers.
meta_description: Dictionary of Modern Serbo-Croatian Language by Miloš Moskovljević: banned by court order in Yugoslavia in 1966 and the whole edition ordered destroyed.
